The mechanism is verifiable from the diff and constitutes a concrete performance/scalability concern for maintainers, though not a correctness defect.

adjudication.rationale: The diff changes `EmbedController#ensure_embeddable` to call `EmbeddableHost.host_allowed?(request.referer)` (app/controllers/embed_controller.rb), which in turn calls `record_for_host` and executes `where("lower(host) = ?", host).first` (app/models/embeddable_host.rb). The migration creating `embeddable_hosts` adds no index on `host` (db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb), and the `lower(host)` predicate would not use a plain `host` index anyway. This is a concrete, diff-grounded performance concern on an embed request hot path, but not a correctness defect by itself.
